test_mathlib_grep: test the mathlib_grep function to search for patterns in Lean mathlib files using ripgrep
test_mathlib_find_name: test the mathlib_find_name function to find exact or partial name matches in mathlib
test_mathlib_read_file: test the mathlib_read_file function to read Lean source files with optional line range filtering
test_find_mathlib_path: test the _find_mathlib_path function to locate the mathlib directory within a workspace
test_grep_fallback: test the _run_grep_fallback function to parse grep output as a ripgrep alternative
